segments.zh: 这很不幸。

segments.en: An interesting way of celebrating New Year's, this is as we said, in the United States, watching the ball drop, kissing someone at midnight.
segments.zh: 庆祝新年的一种有趣方式，正如我们在美国所说，在美国看着球落下，在午夜亲吻某人。

segments.en: So we are really curious to know how you celebrate your New Year's in your country because maybe you have similar traditions or very different things.
segments.zh: 所以我们真的很想知道你如何在你的国家庆祝你的新年，因为也许你有相似的传统或非常不同的东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And I know some places like Italy even have special foods you are supposed to eat to bring wealth and prosperity in the new year.
segments.zh: 而且我知道像意大利这样的一些地方甚至有你应该吃的特殊食物，以在新的一年里带来财富和繁荣。

segments.en: So let us know.
segments.zh: 所以，请告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Happy New Year.
segments.zh: 新年快乐。
